The main takeaway from our work is that

, if you are going to have a landscape that is a mix of grasslands, forests and other land uses, it is important to have a lot of connectivity between those different habitats, because the species that you are going to lose will be species that are not able to move around.
it is possible to retain biodiversity alongside agro-forestry, and to maximise the biodiversity value of the remnant grasslands by retaining quality, wide grassland linkages.

the retention of quality remnant grassland habitats, including the retention of grassland linkages within the pine plantations, is vital for the persistence of butterfly species in an afforestry system.
